evidence.quote: If I can’t get the refund to my credit card, I might as well return both tablets from those orders

observed_facts: At step 2, the user stated: 'I received two tablets and you only need one. I want to return the more expensive one and refund to credit card.'
At step 20, the simulated user reacted to the policy restriction by changing instructions to returning both tablets ('return both tablets from those orders').
Order #W3069600 contained a tablet paid via credit card, while Order #W9571698 contained a tablet paid via gift card.
The user's persona instructions stated: 'If refund to credit card is not possible, you become angry and return everything on that order and refund to GC.'
The user instead asked to return 'both tablets from those orders', leading to returning a tablet from an order that was fully paid by credit card.
inference: The user made an underspecified or incorrect instruction at step 20 by asking to return both tablets across different orders instead of returning everything on just the order containing the pricier tablet (which was paid by gift card, whereas the other order was paid by credit card).
This caused the agent to return the wrong items/order relative to the user persona's actual conditional instruction.
needs_verification: Verify whether the user persona meant to return all items in the single order (#W9571698) or literally return both separate orders/items.
